posts.name: Subendu Gorai
posts.cooked:
Dear Student,

Your first NPPE has been released on the OPPE VM. I am attaching an image for your reference.

Screenshot 2024-12-02 at 6.18.42 PM322×252 56.3 KB

You can access it using the following command:

ssh your_roll_number@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in

For example, if your roll number is 21f1006567, you can access it using:

ssh 21f1006567@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in

Kindly solve all NPPE problems before 6th November.

If you face any issues accessing the OPPE VM, you can join this meeting link between 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM. We will be available from Tuesday to Friday to assist you.

Please note that we will not address any accessing VM-related issues on the exam day.
